item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Auditing
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports database auditing through the pgAudit extension. Audit logs can capture selected PostgreSQL activities such as data access, modifications, role changes, and DDL operations, and can be sent to Azure Monitor Log Analytics.

  • Source: Azure Updates
